column7: Used as a catch-all where a more specific role is meant.
Neymar announces retirement is an announcement, not a sports event.
Universal Pictures, a studio, is typed Movie.
One usage puts a Statement in the participant slot.
Travis Kelce, a person, is typed SportsTeam.
The person authored the statement rather than creating the described situation.
schema.org isRelatedTo links related products or services.
Used for reporting attribution rather than the cause of an event.
Apt here: the nodes really are groups of similar products.
A named person is typed GovernmentOrganization in one usage.
Counts with units are typed as the bare Number datatype.
Observed values are typed as the variable being measured.
byDay is for recurring schedules, not the day a single attack happened.
Used for who made a statement, not who interpreted a claim from media.
Links a chef to a chateau where he trained.
A person is linked to a town through a position property.
The host country is asserted as organizer.
Asserts identity between two distinct fires; sameAs takes a reference URL.
CCTV footage --study--> police.
The age band is the affected group, not the intended audience of a work.
taste preferences is not a condition of the body.
sugar is a substance; NutritionInformation is a structured value about a recipe.
A named executive is typed as a performance role.
oil prices is a value, not a structured price specification.
